verdict.rationale: Authenticator documents its own Export Passwords function, which lets users take autofill passwords elsewhere and import them. However, its backup is cloud-only (Microsoft account or iCloud) to restore into Authenticator itself, and nothing shows TOTP accounts, passkeys, or Verified IDs can be exported. The export format is also never stated, so openness is unproven. Missing for 10: export of OTP/2FA account secrets, export of passkeys and Verified IDs, a documented open file format (e.g. CSV/JSON), and an export path not tied to restoring into Authenticator.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Scroll down to the Autofill section and select Export Passwords.
